about_the_game:
Unleash the beast and rule the roads with the Bengal Rider DLC!  Yasukes ride gets the ultimate upgrade with a fierce Cosmentic bengal tiger vinyl skin. Bold, untamed, and dripping with power, this custom design transforms your car into a symbol of speed, strength, and samurai dominance. Whether you're chasing down enemies or making an entrance worthy of a warlord, the Bengal Rider skin ensures you arrive in unstoppable style.

Features:

🔥 Ride Like a Warrior – The Bengal tiger skin adds raw, untamed energy to your vehicle.
🐯 Fierce & Fearless – Turn heads and strike fear into your rivals.
💨 Speed Meets Style – A sleek, dynamic design worthy of a samurai racer.
⚔️ A Legend on Wheels – Samurai honor meets high-octane horsepower.

Your sword may win battles, but your ride wins respect. Equip the Bengal Rider DLC today and dominate the roads like a true warrior! 🐅🔥
